name: Diageo (Dave Lewis)
verdict: WAIT-then-STARTER 6/10 (full court 2026-07-31, pipeline v1.6). PRIME great-man candidate CONFIRMED on D1+D5 grounds, REFUTED on the valuation grounds it was marketed on. D1 PASS w/ adjacency discount (cost/delever/trade-partner maps and is executing; demand-creation is NOT his demonstrated skill and every sourced Lewis action in 7mo is cost-side). D2 rules CYCLICAL-DOMINANT with a dated expiry: US spirits real per-capita still +11.1% ABOVE the 2019 base (NIAAA-validated) while total alcohol broke the floor (-7.7%); the Gallup structural headline is substantially a reporting artifact (11x divergence vs shipments); GLP-1 ~0.5pp/yr; AND ~60% of Diageo's US decline by Q3 FY26 is company-specific share loss (Don Julio/Casamigos -10/-23% vs a FLAT tequila category) = execution-broken inside a cyclically-soft category, exactly the D2 shape the mechanism requires. Cushion expires ~2028; price/mix inversion (-1.9% H1, still deteriorating) is the one unbounded structural metric. D4 satisfied: +5.21% announce pop fully round-tripped (spot -10.0% below announce close, tape-verified) - the doubt is refunded. D5: THE KITCHEN SINK HAS NOT HAPPENED - Feb-26 was a P&L+dividend reset mislabelled as a sink (H1 exceptionals $140m, ZERO impairment, intangibles untouched at $14.7bn) while Greater China -42.3% and tequila -23.1% sit on pre-Lewis carrying values incl. a re-impairable $379m FY24 Shui Jing Fang reversal; the sink is plausibly the FY26 prelims + Capital Markets Day, Thu 2026-08-06, SIX DAYS OUT. v2 rule: post-arrival sink -> CALENDAR the entry at/after it; the KER lesson does NOT license pre-buying a FUTURE sink. Valuation does NOT carry the case: 13.7x is FY27E-adjusted (14.3x reported), the '20-24x history' is a monotonic 6-year de-rating not a mean, the -60% drawdown is the SECTOR MEDIAN, and DGE is dearer than Pernod on earnings, EV/EBITDA, FCF yield AND de-rating-vs-own-history. Prob-weighted FV 1769p = +8.2% at spot = thin; the case is the dated catalyst + Lewis execution optionality, sized for the 60-80% conditional cohort hit rate.
fv_note: FY28E adj EPS x multiple, GBp: bear $1.30 @ 11x = 1,060 (-35%; STRUCTURAL scenario explicit: price/mix stays inverted, Q4 pull-forward payback compounds, boomer-attrition + GLP-1 ratchet, impairment wave WITHOUT credible FY27 rebase, DB's published FY27 ~-10% vs consensus is roughly this path so bear weight >= 35%); base $1.75 @ 14.5-16x = 1,980 (+21%; cyclical resolves per D2, Accelerate $625m ~50% drop-through, deleverage 3.35x->2.5x by FY28 on $3bn FCF); bull $2.00 @ 17.5x = 2,600 (+59%; Lewis re-rate + share-loss repair + spirits base holds). Prob weights 35/47/18 -> 1,769p (+8.2% + ~2.4%/yr div ~ 6.5%/yr = market-like return with above-market variance AT SPOT - hence entry only post-sink). Consensus (Vuma 20-Jul, n=20): FY26 organic NS -2.1% (favourable end of the -2/-3 guide), EPS 159.6c, FCF $2,911m; FY27 organic op profit spread -9.3% to +5.3% = the market has no idea what he announces.

court_rulings.D2_franchise_intactness: CYCLICAL-DOMINANT (not GENUINELY-UNRESOLVED, not STRUCTURAL) - but a three-layer ruling: (1) total alcohol IS structurally impaired (real per-capita 92.3 vs 2019=100, below the pre-COVID floor; boomer cohort attrition ~1.5pp/yr; health-belief majority-inverted by age); (2) SPIRITS is cyclical-dominant: still +11.1% above the 2019 real per-capita base (proxy validated vs NIAAA hard ethanol within 3pp), weakness concentrated in two policy-specific markets (NAM, Greater China austerity; Europe +8.8%/LAC +16.2%/Africa +17.1% in Q3), peers stabilising (ABI vol +0.8%, Pernod back to vol growth, LVMH W&S +3%), NABCA R12 flattening -1.6->-0.5%, destocking DONE per H1 filing, cannabis refuted by the state natural experiment, GLP-1 ~0.5pp/yr = 10% of the decline, US dietary-guidelines ratchet REVERSED Jan-26; (3) DIAGEO's own damage is majority company-specific (Q3 US depletions ~-10.4% vs category -4.2%; 'Don Julio lost share in tequila AND total spirits' per Diageo's own filing) = execution not demand. Ipsos-precedent test: the structural tail is BOUNDED BY EVIDENCE with a DATE (spirits base-breach ~2028 at current rate) and by observables (Gallup-2026 mid-Aug, NABCA monthly, price/mix, Q4 organic vs implied -2.3/-6.4%) -> tail bounded enough to SIZE (cap 1.5%) not to shun. The ONE unbounded metric = price/mix inversion; it carries its own kill trigger. Attribution: ~30% cyclical / ~40% structural / ~30% demographic-transitional of the TOTAL-alcohol decline - the thesis does not need total alcohol, it needs spirits share-of-throat (all-time-high 42.4% of US alcohol revenue 2025) + the 2019 cushion + Diageo-specific repair.
court_rulings.D1_track_record_adjacency: PASS WITH DISCOUNT. Record: real (Tesco 2014-20: FY15 GBP6.4bn statutory loss -> rebuilt; Homeplus ~GBP4bn 2015, Thailand/Malaysia to CP Mar-2020 ~GBP8bn, Booker, dividend zero->restored; GCA 'serious breach' supplier rebuild verified; note corrections - margin-target attainment and SKU-cull numbers UNVERIFIED, do not cite). Transfers: cost/de-layering (executing: exec clear-out Mar-Jun-26 incl NAM president O'Keeffe, CHRO, CMO-NAM out, Africa remerged into Europe/ME; up-to-30% team cuts Reuters 22-Jul; per-unit cost targets = Tesco device), balance-sheet repair (dividend -50.6% w/ 50c floor Feb-26; EABL 65% -> Asahi $2.3bn @17x EBITDA = -0.25x leverage - NOW LITIGATED in Kenyan courts, completion may slip), trade-partner/distributor rebuild ('customer, customer, customer'). Does NOT transfer: retail price-reset has NO spirits analog - his signalled down-market pivot (FT 25-Feb 'signals price cuts'; lower-end 'significantly underrepresented'; RTD push) is in premium spirits a brand-equity risk, not a cure; demand-creation undemonstrated - zero brand-building initiatives sourced in 7 months. CFO Jhangiani retained (no CFO risk). Corrections to our own sourcing row: NO $3bn disposal target exists ($3bn = the FCF/yr target; Accelerate = $625m savings, pre-Lewis, inherited not replaced); management explicitly disclaimed further brand sales in the H1 release - anyone modelling a big disposal announcement at the CMD bets against a Feb statement.
court_rulings.D5_kitchen_sink_clock: SINK AHEAD AND DATED = the ruling's hinge. Audited H1 FY26 refutes the market's 'Lewis kitchen-sinked in February' narrative: exceptionals $140m (DOWN from $217m), zero brand/goodwill impairment, intangibles $14,694m vs $14,776m = amortisation+FX only. vs FY25 under Jhangiani: $1,369m exceptionals incl $910m impairment. Impairment candidates obvious and un-positioned-for (no sell-side discussion found): Chinese white spirits (H1 -42.3%, CWS volume -50.4%, Shui Jing Fang $379m FY24 impairment REVERSAL re-impairable) + tequila (Casamigos ~$1bn upfront, -30.9% net sales). Feb-26 = P&L reset (guide cut ~4-5pp to -2/-3% organic NS, flat-to-+LSD op profit) + dividend rebase (interim 20.0c vs 40.5c; 30-50% payout, 50c FLOOR -> further-cut risk SPENT, consensus DPS 53.6c). THE EVENT: FY26 prelims + Capital Markets Day Thu 2026-08-06 11:00/13:30 BST (triple-sourced primary; calendared since Feb; Lewis confirmed full strategy lands there). FY26 print itself skews slightly POSITIVE (guide implies Q4 -2.4/-6.6% vs Q3 +0.3% - but Q3 was World Cup sell-in + CNY/Easter timing per Diageo's own attribution, payback real); the downside risk is the FY27 rebase + impairment + strategy, not FY26. Precedent: his Feb reset day = -12.7%. IV 37.5% vs RV 30% = event premium priced. DB downgraded to Hold 29-Jul ('FY27+ consensus materially too optimistic', PT 1,700p UNVERIFIED-flagged then verified vs S&P consensus 1,956p avg) = the most constructive reset-thesis house de-risked 8 days out. Next checkpoint after: Q1 F27 + AGM 5-Nov-26.
court_rulings.D4_doubt_discount: SATISFIED AS ENTRY-MODIFIER (v2: measured at entry date, not announcement). Tape-verified: +5.21% Nov-10-25 announce day; spot 1,634.5 = -10.0% below announce close, -5.3% below pre-announce, -59.5% off the Dec-21 ~4,036p high, +21% off the 24-Mar-26 five-year low 1,351. The pre-paid premium fully decayed - we are NOT in the Niccol-cheered trap. But the +20% run off the March low into an unseen CMD means the tape has partially front-run the good outcome.
court_rulings.valuation_structure: THE MARKETED CHEAPNESS FAILS ON EVERY COMPONENT (this demotes the sourcing row's #1-ranking logic, not the candidate): 13.7x = FY27E adjusted (14.3x reported, LSEG-tied); own-history anchor is a MONOTONIC de-rating 27.1->21.8->20.0->16.4->15.0->13.1 (no mean to revert to; the 24x end unsupported); -60% drawdown = sector median; consistent-basis peers: STZ 10.5x, Pernod 11.8x (cheaper on earnings, EV/EBITDA, FCF yield AND more de-rated vs own history -39% vs -31%), DGE 13.7x 3rd of 6. What SURVIVES: deleverage arithmetic real (FCF $3bn ties, 3.35x -> ~2.5x FY28 IF EABL closes), dividend floored, market prices ~0% of bull. Leverage 3.4x vs 2.5-3.0x target 'no later than FY28'; tariffs ~$100m net ongoing; SAP S/4HANA cutover early FY27 = ops-risk window during max restructuring. Net: a CATALYST case with a dated trigger, NOT a valuation case.

entry_structure_NEW_DOCTRINE.pre_position: NONE. The sink is FUTURE and DATED (6 days): v2 says calendar it; the KER lesson (announcement-day entry) applies only when the sink PRE-dates the hire. Consensus sits at the favourable end of the guide, DB just de-risked, IV carries the event, and his last reset day printed -12.7%. Six days of deferral costs ~nothing; the left tail is fat.
entry_structure_NEW_DOCTRINE.aug6_pack_SINK_TEST: SINK-COMPLETE iff at FY26 prelims/CMD: (a) impairment >= $300m taken (CWS and/or tequila carrying values) OR (b) a numeric FY27 framework that rebases organic op profit at-or-below the +0.2% consensus midpoint. Either fires -> the great-man clock STARTS.
entry_structure_NEW_DOCTRINE.tranche_1_post_sink: 0.3-0.5% NAV (DGE.L on LSE, GBP - not the ADR) on post-print digestion, band 1,430-1,750p. Band deliberately extends ABOVE spot: post-SINK-COMPLETION chasing beats waiting (grounding: 30-46pp cost of waiting after completion); do NOT wait for a lower retest once the sink is confirmed. If the print sells off Feb-style (-12%), the band floor ~1,430 is the add zone, not a stop.
entry_structure_NEW_DOCTRINE.if_sink_not_complete: No impairment + no FY27 rebase + vague strategy = the sink question stays OPEN -> NO entry; recalendar to Q1-F27/AGM 5-Nov-26 and re-court. A cheered CMD with no sink = the pre-paid-premium trap in a new suit.
entry_structure_NEW_DOCTRINE.tranche_2_evidence_pack: to ~1.0% NAV at H1 FY27 (Feb-2027), price-insensitive, conditions: US depletions underperformance vs SipSource category < 1pp (share-loss repair = the Lewis-specific observable) AND price/mix >= -1.0% (pricing-ladder stabilising) AND FY26 Q4 payback contained (FY26 organic NS actual >= -2.5%).
entry_structure_NEW_DOCTRINE.hard_cap: 1.5% NAV while D2 unresolved (structural tail is evidence-bounded with a ~2028 expiry -> SIZE it, don't shun it - Ipsos precedent applied). Sizing basis: 60-80% conditional cohort hit rate, N=5 full-pattern is thin; the Brier record grows the cap, not conviction prose.

kill_triggers: D2->STRUCTURAL reclassify (exit all): US spirits real per-capita breaches its 2019 base before 2028 at an undiminished rate; or NABCA R12 re-breaks below -1.5% and stays there 3+ months

Price/mix kill (the unbounded metric): organic price/mix worse than -2% for two consecutive halves = the pricing ladder is broken structurally, not cyclically - margin thesis dead regardless of volumes
Q4/FY26 organic NS worse than -6.5% (below even the guide-implied floor) = demand deteriorating beyond disclosed phasing

Gallup 2026 (~mid-Aug): participation HOLDS at <=54% or falls = the reporting-artifact defence weakens; treat as a D2 re-court trigger, not an auto-kill (a bounce to 57-59% strengthens cyclical materially)

Adjacency kill: CMD strategy centres on down-market price repositioning of CORE premium brands (JW/Don Julio/Casamigos price cuts) = the one Tesco move with no spirits analog; brand-equity destruction with a multi-year lag
Share-loss kill: Don Julio/Casamigos still losing category share through FY27 = brand equity impaired, not execution - the 'company-specific = fixable' pillar fails
EABL/Asahi collapse (Kenyan litigation; Machakos freeze orders live): leverage stuck >3.2x with the disposal lever explicitly disclaimed = deleverage path broken, dividend floor pressured
Lewis exit or a cheered-CMD-no-sink followed by a second guidance cut within 2 quarters (= he didn't rebase low enough; the Tesco pattern inverted)

red_team_self: COUNTER 1 - '2.3 quarters of cost-cutting hasn't touched the core problem': CONCEDED AS FACT, contested as verdict-changing. Every sourced Lewis action is cost-side; demand-creation undemonstrated; the down-market signal is actively dangerous. Rebuttal: the D2 lane shows the core problem is majority share-loss/execution (distributor economics, tequila over-earning payback) - which IS his lane - and the cohort mechanism never required demand-creation genius, it required reset+cost+capital discipline on an intact franchise. But this is why the score is 6 and the cap is 1.5%, not a conviction size.

COUNTER 2 - 'the -60% already prices the cyclical case; you only win if STRUCTURAL is wrong': PARTLY UPHELD. Prob-weighted FV +8.2% at spot confirms the equity is NOT cheap on our own weights; the valuation lane killed the cheapness pillar the #1-ranking rested on (sector-median drawdown, Pernod cheaper on every axis). The surviving case is narrower than the sourcing row claimed: dated catalyst + conditional cohort alpha + a bear already published by DB (bear weight floored at 35%). If you want cheap category exposure, Pernod is the cheaper asset - DGE is the LEWIS trade, and must be graded as such.

COUNTER 3 - 'motivated sourcing: the thesis NEEDED a PRIME name': UPHELD IN PART, and corrected in the record. The candidates row conflated the $3bn FCF target with a disposal target, carried an unverified GBP4.2bn Homeplus figure, called the multiple 'decade-low' without noting the monotonic de-rating, and tagged PRIME partly on a cheapness claim that failed audit. The court reduces the row's implicit 7-8 to 6/10 and moves the case OFF valuation onto D1/D5. The PRIME tag survives - but on the strength of the Aug-6 setup, not the multiple.

COUNTER 4 - FX/EM: USD-reporting, GBp-quoted; GBPUSD 1.35 moves the pence arithmetic ~1:1; LAC/Africa growth is EM-FX-fragile and the EABL exit removes the fastest-growing region's earnings. Accepted as variance, not thesis-breaking; unhedged by design (equity-over-bonds doctrine tolerates recoverable variance).
